data_description.correction_timeout: How long a manually set temperature is held, in 5 minute intervals. 24 is two hours.
data_description.cover_use_short_tilt: Use the short tilt command instead of the full tilt cycle when opening a blind's slats.
data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the IQtec controller, optionally with a port.

data_description.scan_interval: How often rooms, covers and enabled variables are read from the controller. Lower is more responsive, higher is gentler on the controller. Calendars are read every 5 minutes regardless.

init.description:
How often the controller is read, and how each calendar should be shown. Some calendars are typed as temperature profiles in the controller even though they drive something on or off.
